workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. Here are the 30-minute slots they both have free for the partners' meeting next week:

Mon Nov 16: 09:00, 09:30
Tue Nov 17: 16:30
Wed Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
Thu Nov 19: 10:00
Fri Nov 20: 11:00, 11:30

Please check these times against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which one works for all four of them. If you find a suitable time, please let me know and I will create the booking.
